basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old adventure enthusiast originally from Delhi, India. I have a passion for exploration and connecting with like-minded individuals. I enjoy traveling, hiking, and trying new cuisines. I'm not a fan of staying indoors for too long and prefer outdoor activities. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to manage my own schedule. Typically, I am online during the late evenings, especially after 8 PM IST, when I wrap up my work. Currently in a committed relationship, and we love to explore new experiences together.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a diploma in Graphic Design and have been working in the industry for over five years. My expertise lies in digital illustration and branding. I am mostly self-taught, having honed my skills through online courses and practice. Additionally, I keep myself informed about the latest trends in design and technology.
